title: BBQ Chicken Quesadillas
reject_reason: BBQ sauce + shredded chicken + cheddar in a tortilla is the same dinner as live bbq-chicken-burrito; folded-vs-rolled is not a distinguishing plate, matching this estate's prior bbq-chicken-quesadilla ruling.
